reviews.title: TEMU ads ruin the experience
reviews.text: Decent app and I like some of the features, but the TEMU ads ruin the whole thing. Not the ads in general, the Temu ads particularly. Can’t scroll through the listings without lightly touching the screen and hitting a link to TEMU. Used to be that you could touch any part of the screen and scroll through. Now, if you touch a Temu ad to scroll, no matter how lightly, you open a Temu web page. This has happened dozens of times over the past week. So instead of scrolling this app, it opens Temu, a company who has proven to steal people’s information and sell awful products. This seems predatory and I’m surprised that this app would want to be associated with Temu in this way. Unless, of course, they’ve been bought out by some larger company who also owns Temu. You don’t have to actually hit the link, mind you, you just need to touch the screen while you’re scrolling through. I’ve NEVER had ads respond this way in any other app. Very disappointing. Also disappointing that the developers respond by claiming it’s free and that justifies everything. Use your own app, with ads, and see, pretty sure it will bother you too.

reviews.title: Love but….
reviews.text: I love this app, but iPhone and other devices have changed their settings so you have to have a payment on file. I don’t like to do that due to fraud and I don’t like my kids using my phone accidentally creating charges. Also this is a free app so it’s not necessary so I went online to the website and the only option is the app and it’s forcing me to put a card for payment on file even though this app uses absolutely no payment! If I can’t get the app because I’m not comfortable uploading a new payment method, I should be able to go through the website website at least! There’s too much fraud if my phone gets stolen I do not wanna have any cards on file. The fraud is outrageous. I want no cards linked to my phone. Because it will sync the card across all apps and then you’ll have reoccurring charges and all kinds of things it’s absolutely ridiculous. It’s a money grab.
